annotations.title: What changes at the December timetable change

description:
List what changes in Swiss public transport at the timetable change in December, from a comparison of this year's published timetable with next year's: lines with more or fewer trips on a weekday, a Saturday or a Sunday, new and discontinued lines, stops added to or dropped from a line, first and last trips that move, direct connections between two stations that start or end or get quicker, stops that open, close or are renamed.

Use it for "what changes at Olten in December", "will the S24 still run next year", "what is new in canton Bern from 13 December", "does my bus 31 get more trips". For the planned works of the coming weeks, use station_info; for a journey after the change, plan_journey with a date after it.

Inputs: give one or more of place (a station, stop or town: entries whose stops or communes include it), line (a line's label: "S24", "31"), canton (two letters: "BE", "VD"); with none, the largest changes in the country. limit is how many entries (1–50, default 12).

An operator whose lines are not in next year's file yet is listed in operators_not_yet_published, and its lines are left out rather than called discontinued; an entry marked uncertain may be a gap in next year's data. The comparison is redone every week until the change.

Example: {"place": "Olten"}

limit.description: How many entries to list, the largest changes first.

line.description: A line's label, as on the vehicle: "S24", "IC5", "31".

place.description: A station, stop or town whose changes to list.
